chunks.text: Feed transfer from storage tank 12-T-01 to the reactor (DC-4501) via pump GA-1201A. Suction line 4" passes XV-1201, then splits to two pump casings with 2" discharge through XV-1201A/B and non-return valves into a common 4"-HC-1002-CS02-I line, through FIT-1201 to the reactor. A minimum-flow bypass (FV-1201, opens on low flow) returns flow to suction.

Start permissive: suction valve XV-1201 open (ZSO-1201). Trips: suction pressure low-low PSLL-1201 (0.5 barg), discharge flow low-low FSLL-1201 (9 m3/h), bearing temperature high-high TSHH-1201/TT-1201, bearing vibration high-high VSHH-1201/VT-1201; local emergency-stop hand switch HS-1201. Seal flush per API Plan 11 + Plan 62; PDI-1201 must confirm dP > 1.5 bar (permissive). Logic per SEQ-1201.
Drawing reference is the placeholder TJC-LLD-PID-XXXX. Note 1 states this is sample data for CALIBER purposes only.

Polymer fluid bed dryer YD-2301 (4.0 x 8.5 m, EL +6.00, chain-and-sprocket SCM440 drive, 30 kW motor) receives powder at 4" from centrifuge GF-2210 through XV-2210 (Kadant rotary joint). N2 purge 1" via FV-2302 (trips closed per drawing label), vent to fine dust collector, powder outlet 4" via TV-2301 (trips closed) to downstream.

Start permissive via level switch LSHH-2303 and XV-2210. C&E block EFF-1..5 lists TSHH-2301, FSLL-2302, S5LL-2305, ASHH-2307 (Z50-2304) and MPR-2301 as initiating causes. Lube oil to gearbox OK (PSL-2306) is an other-permissive; a DCS RESET is shown. Local emergency stop HS-1201.

Trip box beside FIT-2301 is titled TSHH-2301 (a temperature tag) but describes "Discharge Flow LOW-LOW 9 m3/h". Tag S5LL-2305 is probably SSLL-2305. ASHH-2307 has no stated measured variable. HS-1201, PDI-1201, RO-1201 and motor EQ1000012011- duplicate Set 1 tags. Notes 2-3 cite Set 1 datasheet/logic (GA-1201A, SEQ-1201).

Catalyst reduction reactor DC-3401A with fixed Pd/Al2O3 bed receives H2 injection (FT/FV-3403) and N2; analysis take-offs on inlet and outlet; in-line heater EA-3401 on the trim gas line. PSV-3401 set 6 barg; 8-point multipoint thermocouple TE-3401.

SEQ-3401. T1: TSHH-3401 high-high >230 degC, 2oo3 voting. T2: PSHH-3404 >5 barg, normally closed, trips on high pressure (PV-3404 trips open). T3: AI-3401 O2 >100 ppm = inerting fail; permissive to enable startup. T4: N2 flow >150 kg/h, maintain/increase flow on trip. T5: heater element over-temperature at skin TC >260 degC. Effects: EFF-1 trip, EFF-2 trip/maintain/increase flow, EFF-3 flow on trip; P1-P4 permissives to enable startup.

Two-stage, two-throw reciprocating recycle gas compressor KC-4501 (gearbox + motor). Feed from tank 12-T-01 via KO drum FA-4510 (6"), suction valves XV-4501, discharge through cooler EA-4502 to reactor loop line 3"-HC-1002-CS021. Anti-surge recycle valve FV-4502 opens on low flow. Support systems: seal gas (nitrogen buffer FT-4506), lube oil (PSL/PSLL-4504, oil pump P1) and jacket cooling water (FSL-4508).

SEQ-4501 start permissives: 1 lube oil pressure (PSL-4504), 2 seal gas nitrogen buffer flow (FT-4506), 3 KO drum level (LT-4510), 4 jacket cooling water flow (FSL-4508). PSLL-4501 suction pressure low-low = suction open permissive/trip. Anti-surge recycle control valving trip per SEQ-4501.

Title block: TITLE KA-4501, Ref TJC-LLD-PID-4501, REV 02, DATE 02. Revision table: Rev 1 = 01 (date 02), Rev 2 = - (date 02). Equipment body and legend use tag KC-4501, not KA-4501. Indicator PI-1201 is printed on the suction line (tag reused from Set 1). Note 1: all values fictional for training.

Cold hexane from upstream pump GA-5610 enters shell-and-tube heater EA-5601 (N1, 6"), heated by MP steam on the tube side (N3 4" in, N4 3" out) via TV-5602 (air-actuated, fails safe in a specific position). Hot hexane leaves N2 to the recycle system; condensate leaves through steam trap ST-5604 to the condensate system.

Interlock/control loop: PDT-5605 differential > 0.7 bar = fouling alarm (PDAH-5605, A1, EFF-2). Start permissive: PDT-5605 condensate trap fouling alarm and TI-5604 condensate trap check. TCV-5602/TV-5602 failure position C1 (EFF-1). PSV-5607 set 16 barg (R1, EFF-3).
Note 5 states "Fictional diagram for training purposes"; pump GA-5610 is labelled "upstream fictional pump". Materials note 4 lists SS304L and SA-516-70 without saying which part each applies to.

LP separator FA-6710 with demister mat; bottoms (hexane + polymer) leave via 6"-HC-6710-WCC-I through TB-6702 block valve and level valve LV-6701 (Fisher 667 diaphragm actuator, DVC6200 positioner, HART communicator; globe, body WCC, ASME 300#, 300 mm). Instrument air 3"-IA-6702-WCC-I below 1.0 barg triggers PSL-6702.

Logic panel SEQ-6701: LSHH-6710 >85% (1oo2) -> EFF-1 open LV-6701 fully; LSLL-6710 15% (1oo2) -> EFF-4 DCS alarm; HS-6701 manual ESD (1oo1) -> EFF-3 vent actuator; PSL-6702 <1.0 barg -> EFF-3 vent actuator and EFF-4 DCS alarm. Permissives: 1 PI-6702 > 1.2 barg, 2 DVC6200 healthy, 3 HV-6701 bypass closed.

Axial induced-draft cooling tower fan CT-7801 (6 FRP blades, composite drive shaft, 55 kW TEFC IP56, 380 V/3 Ph/50 Hz, non-hazardous area) with gearbox and cooling tower cell; basin drain and vents shown. Spare cell CT-7802 is started by interlock.

INTERLOCK SEQ-7801: fan vibration VSHH-7802 >9 mm/s -> trip fan motor; gearbox oil temp TSHH-7802 =90 degC -> annunciate alarm on DCS; gearbox oil pressure PSL-7807 0.8 barg and fan motor overload MPR-7801 -> request start of spare CT-7802. Start permissive (AND-gate): gearbox oil level OK, basin level normal (LSL-7804), lockout release logic.

A second vibration row lists VSHH-7802 with "=90 degC" (looks copied from the oil-temp row). Lockout release text refers to "image_0.png" and is garbled. Instruments PT/PSLL/FI-1201 reuse Set 1 tags. Reference printed as "Ref. Plog." Legend text mentions "IMAGE 1" placeholders.

Reflux accumulator drum (1600 mm dia, 9.6 m3 T-T, SA-516 Gr.70, PSV set 10 barg, PCV split-range, C/L 4500 mm) receives overhead from column DA-8910 (8"-HC-1002-CS02-I via TT-8911). Pumps GA-8920A/B return reflux (6", FT-8912) and send product out (PT-8913); boot drain HV-8904 with auto-drain vent. Minimum-flow bypass FV-8911 opens on low flow.

SEQ-8901: LSHH-8901 >85% (1oo2 latched) -> EFF-1 trip column feed; LSLL-8901 15% (1oo2) -> EFF-2 trip reflux pump GA-8920 A/B; PSHH-8902 >8 barg (1oo2) -> EFF-3 open vent PCV-8905; HS-8901 manual E-stop -> EFF-4 DCS alarm. Start permissive is an AND-gate. Suction: ZSO-4901 open; PSV-8901 labelled "Suction Pressure LOW-LOW, setpoint 0.5 barg".

The drum body carries no equipment tag; FA-8901 is inferred from SEQ-8901 and datasheet TJC-LLD-GA-FA-8901. GA-8920A is labelled Standby and GA-8920B Duty. PSV-8901 is used as a low-low pressure switch tag. PI/PSLL/XV-1201A/B/TSHH-1201 reuse Set 1 tags; drum flow label FI-8012 vs FI-8912 unclear. Note 1: sample data only.

Case 1 pack: P&ID explains how the system works; Plot Plan shows where equipment is located; together they give operational context. Extractable content: equipment list, flow paths, piping and valve logic, sensors/transmitters, control valves, DCS monitoring points, trips, alarms, interlocks, SOPs, incidents, live data.

Maintenance History workbook uses Equipment Tag as the common key across datasets. Visible columns: WO_Number, Notification_No, Report_Date, Start_Date, Completion_Date, Status, Equipment, Equipment description, Functional location, Area_Code, Area_Name, Plant, Work_Type, Discipline, Priority. Work types include inspection, preventive, predictive, calibration, corrective and overhaul. A second sheet 'Explanation' documents each column. The actual rows were not provided.

Plot plan sheet for GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP), drawing TJC-LLD-PP-GA-1201A Rev 0, sheet 1 of 1, titled 'PLOT PLAN / EQUIPMENT LOCATION' - AREA 1200 - HEXANE FEED SYSTEM. Equipment location detail: area 1200 - FEED PREPARATION & PURIFICATION; grid ref A-3; elevation EL +0.00; functional location TJC-LLD-1200-01; footprint 3.5 x 5.0 m (approx). On the unit plot plan the equipment is labelled GA-1201A / A1200 / EL +0.00 and is the highlighted 'SUBJECT EQUIPMENT'.

PLOT PLAN - LINEAR LOW DENSITY POLYETHYLENE (LLDPE) UNIT. Unit Layout at Grade | Highlighted: GA-1201A - HEXANE FEED PUMP (Area 1200). All eight equipment are drawn inside the BATTERY LIMIT (approx E100-E260 / N100-N260, 20 m grid; N labels run N100 at top to N260 at bottom). Upper row (N132): GA-1201A (E124, A1200, EL +0.00); YD-2301 (E160, A2300, EL +6.00); DC-3401A (E196, A3400, EL +0.00); KC-4501 (E232, A4500, EL +0.00). Lower row (N204): EA-5601 (E124, A5600, EL +0.00); LV-6701 (E160, A6700, EL +3.00); CT-7801 (E196, A7800, EL +12.00); FA-8901 (E232, A8900, EL +4.50). OPL-GA-1201A-01 - ONE POINT LESSON (OPL), Sheet 1 of 1. Title: Mechanical Seal Flush (API Plan 11) Verification. Discipline: Mechanical. Equipment: GA-1201A - HEXANE FEED PUMP. Area / Unit: 1200 - HEXANE FEED SYSTEM. Related Interlock: SEQ-1201 (SIL 1). P&ID Ref: TJC-LLD-PID-1201. Classification: Trouble Case (Aspect: P-Q-C-D-S-M-E). 1. PURPOSE / OBJECTIVE: This One Point Lesson explains mechanical seal flush (api plan 11) verification for GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP) in the HEXANE FEED SYSTEM. Confirm seal flush dP > 1.5 bar before start. Low flush = seal face overheating and hexane leak to atmosphere. The lesson gives operators and technicians the key knowledge and the correct step-by-step method so the task is done safely, correctly and consistently every time. Hazard note: this equipment is HIGH CRITICAL handling n-Hexane at up to 16 barg / 80 degC. Observe the following before and during the task:

2. SAFETY PRECAUTIONS: Hazard note: this equipment is HIGH CRITICAL handling n-Hexane at up to 16 barg / 80 degC. Observe the following before and during the task: (1) Apply LOTO (Lock-Out Tag-Out) and prove zero energy before starting work. (2) Isolate, depressurise, drain and purge the equipment; obtain a valid work permit. (3) Wear the correct PPE: coverall, safety shoes, gloves, goggles and hearing protection. (4) Beware of stored mechanical energy (springs, rotating inertia) and pinch points. (5) Use certified lifting gear and correct manual-handling technique for heavy parts. 3. TOOLS & MATERIALS REQUIRED: Standard mechanical hand tools & calibrated torque wrench; LOTO padlocks and permit; Laser/dial alignment kit (as applicable); Feeler gauges, dial indicator, seal/bearing pullers; Correct spare parts and gaskets per the BOM; Lifting gear and slings (certified).

4. DETAILED PROCEDURE / STEPS (Step | Action | Check / Acceptance): 1. Line up discharge flush to seal chamber and open flush isolation | Isolation & LOTO verified. 2. Check PDI-1201 reads 1.5-2.5 bar dP across the flush orifice RO-1201 | Parts match BOM / spec. 3. Verify no visible leak or drip at the gland / seal drain | Torque / clearance to spec. 4. If dP low, isolate and inspect orifice RO-1201 for plugging by polymer/dirt | No leak / smooth operation. 5. Confirm quench (Plan 62) N2/steam is lined up to the outboard side | Record in equipment history.

5. COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING (Symptom | Likely Cause | Action): 1. Hexane leak observed at GA-1201A seal gland during operation, seal dr. | API Plan 11 flush orifice RO-1201 partially plugged causing seal face. | Replaced JC T2100 mechanical seal cartridge, cleaned flush orifice, v. 2. GA-1201A tripped on VSHH-1201 high vibration 7.4 mm/s | Angular misalignment 0.12 mm/100mm after foundation settlement | Laser re-aligned pump/motor, re-shimmed motor feet, vibration back to. 3. Bearing DE noisy with rising temperature TI-1201 trend | Outer race spalling on DE bearing due to prolonged misalignment | Renewed DE bearing 7310 BECBM, flushed housing, refilled ISO VG 68.

6. KEY LEARNING POINTS: (1) Confirm seal flush dP > 1.5 bar before start. Low flush = seal face overheating and hexane leak to atmosphere. (2) Respect the interlock SEQ-1201: e.g. PSLL-1201 trips at < 0.5 barg - never defeat it without a permit. (3) Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and the P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-1201 before working on GA-1201A. (4) Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth. opl.title: Reduction DC-3401A - 4-Step Overview

Reduction: introduce H2, hold about 12 hours (PdO + H2 -> Pd)
Cooling: cool all bed below 29 degC, then hold under N2 at 2 kg/cm2
Log every step transition and confirm permissives before the next step

issues.issue: The Common Problems & Troubleshooting table is asset-level, not lesson-specific: of 168 rows only 51 are distinct and 150 rows repeat on sibling OPLs of the same asset (e.g. the seal-flush / misalignment / bearing table also appears on the minimum-flow OPL, OPL-GA-1201A-04). Each OPL carries exactly 3 rows.
issues.suggested_action: Treat the table as a failure-mode catalogue per asset. Use opl_troubleshooting.opl_count_same_asset_same_row to de-duplicate before counting 'cases'; do not present a repeated row as that OPL's own root cause without confirming with the author. Not loaded into incidents/tacit_knowledge for this reason.

issues.issue: 12 troubleshooting rows on 6 OPLs are cut off mid-phrase in the PDF ('...seal dr', '...causing seal face', '...cleaned flush orifice, v', '...vibration back to'); punctuation of the cut-off also differs from page to page.
issues.suggested_action: Kept verbatim and shaded orange. Do not paraphrase the missing words into the knowledge base; obtain the full OPL text if needed.

issues.issue: The Check / Acceptance column is a fixed 5-line template per discipline (Mechanical, Process / Operations, Instrument) repeated by step number regardless of the action, e.g. step 3 'Torque / clearance to spec' on a flow-check step, or 'Parts match BOM / spec' on a lube-level check. Real acceptance values live in the Action text (see opl_quant_values).
issues.suggested_action: Use the Action text and opl_quant_values for acceptance criteria; treat check_acceptance as a generic checklist label (check_acceptance_origin states the template).

issues.issue: The footer line 'Cross-ref tag <tag> across Datasheet, GA, P&ID, Interlock and Maintenance History' names the wrong asset on 28 of 56 OPL pages (GA-1201A is printed on DC-3401A, KC-4501, EA-5601 and LV-6701 sheets) and is missing on 5. OPL-DC-3401A pages also hold a hidden 'DUMMY / TRAINING DOCUMENT - Knowledge Hub exercise. Fictional data' note under an overlay. One page (OPL-GA-1201A-04) prints it as 'Notes:' beside the sign-off block.
issues.suggested_action: Use the Equipment field in the OPL header (asset_tag) as the canonical tag; ignore the footer for joins. footer_tag_matches_equipment shows which pages are affected.

issues.issue: Text extraction of the PDF is unreliable: a stray ';' after 'P&ID', blank bullets (tools bullet 1 on OPL-EA-5601-03/04, key point 2 on all 7 EA-5601 OPLs), 'Operating procedure &' cut off on OPL-LV-6701-05, 'the P&ID' missing from the LV-6701 cross-check line, and a garbled Likely Cause cell on OPL-DC-3401A-07 are patched on screen by white overlay boxes.
issues.suggested_action: All values in the opl_* sheets were taken from the rendered page, not the raw text layer. Re-ingesting this PDF by plain text extraction will reproduce the defects.

issues.suggested_action: Confirm which tag is the instrument-air supply gauge on LV-6701 (check P&ID set 6 / GA-1201A-style datasheet); fix the tag or the description. Not edited in instruments.

issues.issue: OPL-FA-8901 sets PSV-8901 at 10 barg (procedure step and troubleshooting row of the PSV testing OPLs); instruments INST-075 gives PSV-8901 as 'Suction pressure 0.5 barg' and is already flagged REVIEW (it duplicates the PSLL-1201 value).
issues.suggested_action: Take 10 barg for PSV-8901 (matches the OPL hazard note and design pressure 10 barg); correct INST-075 after checking the P&ID 8 / datasheet. Not edited in instruments.
